scripts.app: node scripts/check-node.mjs && npm run bootstrap && npm run build && npm start
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-node.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && svelte-check --tsconfig apps/desktop/renderer/tsconfig.json --threshold error
scripts.build: node scripts/check-node.mjs && npm run guard:no-rebuild && npm run agent:macos && electron-vite build
scripts.dev: node scripts/check-node.mjs && npm run agent:macos && electron-vite dev
scripts.verify: npm run guard:no-rebuild && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run scan:transcripts
scripts.package:mac: node scripts/check-node.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/package-macos.mjs
